summary: WeShop Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and Operating and Financial Review for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes forward-looking statements about planned US expansion and a share-based ShareBack Plan but discloses no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring. This is a routine periodic interim report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a quarterly earnings release, with no transaction terms, premiums, or deal mechanics. There is no action to monitor; the filing is informational only.
